bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12" x 12" x 6" and small clutches up to 6" x 9", which do not need to be clear, are allowed. All bags are searched.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12" x 12" x 6"
Small clutches up to 6" x 9" (clear or not)
Medically necessary bags and diaper bags with the guest using them
Official tour VIP merchandise bags given out on show day
prohibited: Clear bags larger than 12" x 12" x 6"
Bags with patterns that block the contents from view
bagPolicy.note: VIP merchandise bags must be shown at the entrance and screened. There is no coat check.

rideshare.summary: For rideshare pickup, use Freedom Way, Mehring Way, Ted Berry Way, or Elm Street.

accessibility.summary: The indoor and outdoor venues are fully accessible, with ADA-compliant entrances and seating. Specify ADA, hearing-impaired, or visually-impaired seating needs when you buy, on Ticketmaster.com or at the box office; ADA sections are best available. Service animals covered under ADA regulations are allowed.

reEntry.summary: Official venue guidance states that guests may not re-enter after leaving the venue.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The three entrances are the Race Street Entrance by the Race Street turnaround, the Tunnel Entrance beneath the turnaround on The ICON Festival Stage level, and the Mehring Way Entrance up steps from Mehring Way. For The ICON Festival Stage at Smale Park, use the Carousel Entrance on Ted Berry Way. You can line up outside the Race Street entrance up to an hour before doors.
